THIRD-PARTY SOFTWARE NOTICES AND INFORMATION
For the browser modules bundled into the vendored Monaco Editor runtime
Do Not Translate or Localize

Upstream's own ThirdPartyNotices.txt covers the components Microsoft incorporated into
monaco-editor itself. It does not cover monaco-editor's own npm dependencies, which its
ESM build inlines under `esm/external/`. Redistributing those packages carries their MIT
notice with them, so the notice for each one is reproduced below.

`esm/external/monaco-lsp-client` is not a separate package: it is a directory of the
microsoft/monaco-editor repository at the commit recorded in package.json, and is covered
by the LICENSE beside this file.

This file is maintained by Localix, not generated by upstream's build. Refreshing the
vendored runtime replaces `esm/`, `LICENSE`, and `ThirdPartyNotices.txt`, but not this
file; `bun run check:vendor` fails if a bundled package here loses its notice or a newly
bundled one appears without one.
